item.title: Meta’s Threads Delivers a Major Blow to Elon Musk’s X, Surpasses X on Mobile Daily Active Users
item.description: Meta’s Threads has overtaken X in daily active users on Android and iOS, reaching 141.5 million users. While X still dominates web traffic, Threads’ rapid mobile growth highlights a major shift in the social media competition.

item.title: Budget 2026 Buzz: Will joint taxation for married couples become reality in India? Explained
item.description: India may introduce joint taxation for married couples in Budget 2026, allowing combined income filing, higher exemptions, and easier compliance. Could this family-friendly tax overhaul change the way households manage finances in India?

item.title: Salman Khan Skips Court in Pan Masala Ad Case; Demand for Non-Bailable Warrant Grows
item.description: Salman Khan failed to appear before the Kota Consumer Court in the Rajshree Pan Masala ad case. The complainant has demanded non-bailable warrants, alleging misleading advertising and harmful celebrity endorsements. The next hearing is scheduled for February 5.

item.title: Viral: Prince Harry’s ‘Alarmingly Bald’ Look Outside London Court Shock Netizens; Watch Here
item.description: Prince Harry’s courthouse appearance in London sparked online chatter, not for his trial, but for his noticeably thinning hair. Social media users contrasted it with Meghan Markle’s nostalgic video, dubbing him “alarmingly bald” and fueling memes and jokes.

item.title: ‘Major Security Threat’: PM Modi stresses upon action against infiltrators and urban naxalism
item.description: PM Modi calls infiltration a “major security threat” and urges strict action to identify and deport illegal entrants. He also flagged urban Naxalism as a growing challenge, warning that ideological threats could undermine national security and citizens’ rights.

item.title: Indian Stock Market Struggles for Direction as Sensex and Nifty Open Weak Amid Volatility
item.description: Indian equities opened lower on Wednesday as weak global cues and cautious investor sentiment weighed on benchmarks. Despite a brief recovery, selling pressure returned, keeping Sensex and Nifty in the red after Tuesday’s sharp market crash.

item.title: Tiruppur MP K. Subbarayan slams centre over US tariffs, warns of textile industry collapse
item.description: Tiruppur MP K. Subbarayan has urged the central government to urgently address the crisis caused by US tariff hikes on textiles, warning of MSME closures, while also demanding justice and relief for protesting poultry farmers.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Skyrocket as Global Uncertainty Fuels Safe-Haven Demand
item.description: Gold and silver prices surged sharply in Indian markets amid rising global uncertainty and tariff tensions. Strong safe-haven demand pushed gold up over 3.5 percent, while silver also gained, signaling cautious investor sentiment worldwide.

item.title: Delhi-NCR Braces for Fog, Rain, and Severe Pollution as Weather Shifts
item.description: Delhi-NCR is witnessing changing winter conditions with fog, light rain forecasts, and strong winds ahead. While temperatures remain low, hazardous air quality continues to pose serious health risks, prompting advisories for residents to stay cautious.
